responsibility: Submit a sealed recording to cloud GLIM, provide isolated official map editing, and return immutable map versions
produces: map.json with recording-start-complete lidar_link route, explicit trajectoryPoseFrame and routeCoverage receipt
trajectory-poses.json with GLIM timestamps, quaternions and explicit lidar_link poseFrame
implementationNote: The cloud source is traj_lidar and is now declared as lidar_link instead of being silently consumed as base_link. Missing frame fields remain a bounded legacy-lidar read only; mismatched map/optimized frames fail before registration. This frame metadata change is locally verified but not newly deployed by the 2026-08-24 GitHub-only closure.
sourceProvenance: V2 workstation adapter over the existing pinned Alibaba Cloud Jazzy GLIM pipeline
